condition: read_parquet(use_pyarrow=True) on a remote (fsspec/S3) directory raises FileNotFoundError, and on a list of remote paths it raises TypeError, because the source is opened as file objects instead of being passed as paths.
workaround: Use the native reader (leave out use_pyarrow), or call pyarrow.parquet.read_table directly with filesystem=... and convert the result with pl.from_arrow.
